faqs.a:
The city council, upon finding that an application under this division is consistent
               with the public interest, safety and welfare, may grant by ordinance a revocable permit
               for such application in whole or in part, subject to such agreements, conditions,
               charges, assessments and taxes as the city council may impose upon the applicant;
               provided that the right to revoke said permit without cause at any time, whether or
               not said right is expressly reserved in the permit, shall be retained by the city
               council.
(Code 1960, § 7A-3; Code 1981, § 9-4)
Charter reference—
Revocable permits, §
12.8
.
State Law reference—
Irrevocable grant of franchise prohibited, Colo. Const. Art. II, § 11.
